description.value: Tan's Kitchen is a Chinese restaurant on the West Island Highway in Parksville serving Cantonese and Szechuan dishes including Salt & Pepper Squid, Ginger Beef, and General Tso's Chicken. The restaurant offers all-you-can-eat service and outdoor dining, and advertises no MSG in its food. It sits on a main cycling corridor along eastern Vancouver Island, making it a convenient full-service meal stop.

address.value: 332 Island Hwy, West, Parksville, BC V9P 1K8
